content.title: Module 8
content.subtitle: The Future of Energy: Innovation for Sustainable Development
content.body: Thank you for taking the time to complete the survey! Your insights are invaluable to us and help us continuously improve our modules. We hope you found this learning experience valuable and engaging.

nextBlock.title: Innovation in Sustainable Energy
nextBlock.cta: Module 8 explores future energy trends and projections, emphasizing the creation of enabling environments for innovation. It highlights the role of partnerships, collaboration, and inclusive practices in driving sustainable energy transitions. Learners will gain tools to foster innovation ecosystems and lead transformative change across the global energy landscape.
